- [IDAT.1.2] **Opaque public types.** `ds_engine_t`,
  `ds_fact_t` and `ds_schema_t`
  are forward-declared structs in public headers; their
  layouts are private to the owning module (an internal
  header, **never `libds.h`**). Integrators receive and pass
  pointers; never dereference. `ds_json_t` is likewise
  opaque (accessor-mediated): its layout (`struct ds_json` /
  `ds_json_kv`) lives in the private `internal/json.h`, never
  `libds.h`, which exposes only the forward typedef, the
  `ds_json_kind_t` enum, and the accessor/builder API.
  `ds_stream_ev_t` is **not**
  opaque: it is a transparent, library-owned callback payload
  (an inline tagged union, [IDAT.7.1]) the stream callback reads
  field-by-field — borrowed lifetime, public layout.
